Sam (Sales): Heads-up team — AcmeCorp's InfoSec asked for our completed security questionnaire (SIG) + supporting evidence by EOW. I started a mapping doc and a secure bucket. Need owners for Qs. Link: https://redwood.internal/drive/acme/sig (private folder)
Priya (Security): Thanks Sam. Quick clarifying Qs: is the POC full-prod network or isolated sandbox? Also do they require evidence for key rotation policy + HSM usage?
Sam (Sales): It's a limited POC in their VPC peering test env — not full-prod. They did ask for KMS rotation cadence and whether customer-managed keys are supported.
Liam (Solutions Eng): Adding technical notes — POC handles inference over reserved capacity; we will use customer VPC with peered subnets. I'll upload a simple architecture diagram and the flow for data-at-rest/encrypt-in-transit. S3 path for evidences (internal): gs://redwood-secure/acme-poc/sig/
Liam (Solutions Eng): Also dropping the presigned-url example for uploads the CS team can use:
```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-secure/acme-poc/sig/IR_response.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
Mike (Customer Success): I'll collect SOC2 type II (redacted), latest pen test exec summary, and network diagram. I'll name files using question IDs (e.g., Q12_subprocessors.csv, Q48_KMS-rotation.pdf). ETA tomorrow midday.
Priya (Security): For the SOC2 doc — we can share the cover + assertion publicly, but we need Legal sign-off for any raw evidence that contains IP or internal incident details. Also confirm whether the pen-test report should be fully redacted.
Tess (Legal): Confirmed. We require an NDA before sharing any internal incident timelines or raw log extracts. Pen-test exec summary is ok to share; full report must have vuln details redacted unless customer signs an NDA and we approve scope. I can prepare a short NDA template.
Sam (Sales): OK — I'll send Acme the standard redwood NDA and flag the parts about pen-test/IR. Meanwhile, Priya — can you own Q22 (data residency) and Q48 (KMS rotation) answers?
Priya (Security): Happy to. For Q48, I'll attach the KMS key rotation policy PDF and provide the ARN for customer-managed keys. For Q22 I'll list region mapping and our Private deployment options (VPC, on-prem).
Liam (Solutions Eng): I'll take Q12 (third-party subprocessors) — I have the vendor inventory CSV at https://redwood.internal/inventory/vendors.csv — will extract relevant rows and upload as Q12_subprocessors.csv.
Mike (Customer Success): Uploaded initial artifacts to secure bucket (tags: draft):
- gs://redwood-secure/acme-poc/sig/SOC2_cover_redwood_2025.pdf
- gs://redwood-secure/acme-poc/sig/Pentest_execsummary_2025.pdf
- gs://redwood-secure/acme-poc/sig/arch-diagram-v1.png
(upload-bot): file uploaded: SOC2_cover_redwood_2025.pdf (gs://redwood-secure/acme-poc/sig/)
Priya (Security): One more ask: Acme wants to verify our CSIRT contact and IR SLA window. I'll attach our IR runbook excerpt (redacted) and the on-call escalation matrix.
Tess (Legal): Sam — before you share the IR runbook excerpt externally, please attach the signed NDA to the upload record and mark the file as redacted. I'll sign off on the redaction list.
Sam (Sales): Noted — action items and owners:
- Sam: send NDA to Acme, track signature (today) :spiral_calendar: 
- Priya: prepare Q22 + Q48 docs + upload redacted IR excerpt (tomorrow) 
- Liam: extract subprocessors list and upload Q12_subprocessors.csv (tomorrow morning) 
- Mike: finalize SOC2/pen-test naming and mark drafts (tomorrow midday) 
- Tess: provide NDA template and redaction guidance (today)
If anyone needs me to ping Acme for acceptance before we upload, call it out.
Liam (Solutions Eng): I'll ping Acme PM for confirmation on dataset examples they want to see in the POC — will CC you Sam.
Mike (Customer Success): Quick note — Acme asked whether we can provide an ephemeral demo account instead of sharing screenshots with PII. I'll create a demo account and flag it in the thread when ready.
Sam (Sales): Great. Closing this thread with timeline: target to have upload-ready artifacts by 2025-11-07 16:00 UTC. I'll update the mapping doc as files appear. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
